title: U.S. customer electricity interruption duration: Calendar Year 2021
summary: EIA's 2021 release records elevated national interruption duration when major events are included. Major-event and non-major-event values must remain separate.
key_findings: EIA's 2021 release records elevated national interruption duration when major events are included.
Method: EIA-861 utility reporting summarized as average annual customer interruption duration.
Denominator: U.S. electricity customers represented in the EIA-861 reliability data.
why_it_matters: This observation adds one of three time points for the u.s. customer electricity interruption duration series and keeps its unit, denominator, period, geography, method, attribution, and series-break context attached.
ftfn_relevance: Adds one of twelve Phase 56A primary records for asset-level grid, water, storage, and mineral performance.
Supports a within-domain time series without creating a cross-domain score.
Makes revision, denominator, and method limits visible before a direction is described.
evidence_limits: Major-event and non-major-event values must remain separate.
The observation is bounded to United States and the stated period.
The denominator is U.S. electricity customers represented in the EIA-861 reliability data.
Two-point movement is not presented as a durable trend without an explicit caveat.
